manaNeeded: {2}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Repeat.
